title: What is the sum that client number 4's account has following transaction 85
question: What is the sum that client number 4's account has following transaction 851? Who owns this account, a man or a woman?

prediction.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T.XCL_049 = 'VYDAJ' THEN -T.XCL_052 ELSE T.XCL_052 END) AS sum_after_transaction, CASE C.XCL_010 WHEN 'M' THEN 'man' ELSE 'woman' END AS owner_gender FROM trans AS "T" JOIN account AS "A" ON "T".XCL_047 = "A".XCL_001 JOIN disp AS "D" ON "A".XCL_001 = "D".XCL_015 JOIN client AS "C" ON "D".XCL_014 = "C".XCL_009 WHERE C.XCL_009 = 4 AND T.XCL_046 <= 851 GROUP BY C.XCL_010

arguments.sql:
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN T.XCL_049 = 'VYDAJ' THEN -T.XCL_052 ELSE T.XCL_052 END) AS sum_after_transaction,
    CASE C.XCL_010 WHEN 'M' THEN 'man' ELSE 'woman' END AS owner_gender
FROM trans T
JOIN account A ON T.XCL_047 = A.XCL_001
JOIN disp D ON A.XCL_001 = D.XCL_015
JOIN client C ON D.XCL_014 = C.XCL_009
WHERE C.XCL_009 = 4
  AND T.XCL_046 <= 851
GROUP BY C.XCL_010
